caption: The drawing features a round medallion or plate with a detailed border composed of repeated circular and star-like patterns, rendered in shades of gray. Within the central circular area, there is a scene depicting two horses pulling a wagon with large wheels, carrying multiple people. Some of these people are seated and one is pointing or holding an object aloft. In the background, there are several other people grouped together, standing or sitting, with trees and clouds or smoke depicted above them. The scene appears to be on uneven or crosshatched ground. Adjacent to the medallion, toward the lower right, there is a small vertical rectangular segment separated from the main design, displaying a detail of the border pattern in closer view. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with no additional elements. The entire image is executed in monochrome, utilizing various shades of gray for shading and texture.
title: Glass Tray
